title: Learn typing through adventure
subtitle: Worlds, missions, XP, streaks, clans and clan wars — powered by a reusable game engine.
howSubtitle: Four steps from your first keystroke to full typing speed.
howStep1Desc: Enter the batch code your teacher gave you to join your class.
howStep2Desc: Start as Beginner, Intermediate or Expert — games adapt to your level.
howStep3Desc: Work through 16 worlds and dozens of games — keys, letters, words, then sentences.
howStep4Desc: Earn XP, keep your streak alive, join a clan and climb the leaderboard.
gamesTitle: Dozens of games, one skill at a time
gamesSubtitle: Every game teaches something new — from your first key press to full-speed sentences.
worldsSubtitle: Progress unlocks new worlds, harder challenges and bigger rewards.
featuresTitle: Everything that keeps students coming back
featuresSubtitle: Built like a game, grounded in real typing skill.
featureXpDesc: Every game and mission earns experience that levels you up.
featureStreakDesc: Practice a little every day and watch your streak grow.
schoolsSubtitle: Made for teachers and schools running typing practice at scale.
schoolsPoint1Desc: Students join with a code from their teacher — no open sign-up, no spam accounts.
schoolsPoint2Desc: Every student is tied to a real roll number inside their batch.
schoolsPoint3Desc: Teachers and admins track XP, accuracy and speed across every batch.
finalCtaTitle: Ready to start your typing adventure?
finalCtaSubtitle: Join with your batch code and make your first move.
